body:
> From the review of PR #186 (#182, merged 2026-08-29). Both halves were in #182's Done-when / Contract and did not ship; neither regresses main.

## What

1. **`hkb init` repairs a pinned launch** (`src/init.js` `boardProfiles` ~719, `init` ~880): today, over a board whose `claude` launch is pinned without `{hook_settings}`, init re-writes the file, expands the profiles (adds `"effort": null`), keeps the broken pin and says nothing. Do what doctor's fix text says: insert `{hook_settings}` right after the `--disallowedTools` group and print one line per profile — `inserted "{hook_settings}" after --disallowedTools in the claude launch` — or, when the pin adds nothing but `--model`/`--effort`, drop it, move those into the profile fields, and say so. Never silent. Test: a pinned scratch board → init output names the insertion; second run says nothing.
2. **Refuse `effort` where the harness has no flag** (`src/board.js` `loadBoard` validation ~410): `"effort": "high"` on `codex` or `copilot-cli` renders `… --effort high <PROMPT>` (measured) and the first spawn dies on the CLI's own error. Refuse at load time — exit 2, `profile "codex" sets effort, but its harness (codex) takes no --effort flag; remove it` — for any profile whose `launch[0]` is not `claude`; `claude-action` accepted and documented as ignored (or plumbed into `claude_args` in `templates/actions/kanban-worker-claude.yml`, which is hand-written today and carries no effort).
3. **One test for the wiring**: `spawnWorker` (`src/dispatch.js` ~147, `effort: profile.effort || ''`) has none — dropping the token passes 815/815. The codex dry-run test at `test/harness.test.js` ~445 is the template.
4. `docs/harnesses.md` ~38-51: say which placeholders a pinned claude launch must carry (`{hook_settings}`, `{allowed_tools}`, `{model_args}`, `{prompt}`) and that doctor checks `{hook_settings}`.
5. Wiki: re-stamp `operator-seat`, `review-loop`, `up-and-down`, `web-board` (stale from #186's model.js/board.js/dispatch.js edits; no claim changes).

## Done when

- Scratch board with a pinned launch lacking `{hook_settings}` → `hkb init` prints the insertion line and doctor is clean afterwards; re-run is silent.
- `"effort": "high"` on a codex profile → exit 2 with the message above; on claude → `--effort high` rendered (test through `spawnWorker`).
- `npm run lint && npm test` green; `npm run smoke` (init output changed).
goal: A pinned claude launch that lacks a placeholder is repaired by hkb init with one line saying what it inserted, an effort on a codex/copilot profile is refused at load time naming the fix, and spawnWorker has a test that pins the --effort token
title: hkb init applies the launch-hooks fix and says so; effort is refused on profiles whose harness has no such flag
